author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Autotask PSA (Datto, now Kaseya) has no syslog or security audit export. Its REST API webhooks post record changes for companies, contacts, configuration items, tickets and ticket notes. A webhook has no header setting, so point it at a relay that checks the X-Hook-Signature HMAC and forwards the body to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration with Authorization: Bearer <integration key>. Every delivery goes to CloudAudit: the event name entity.action, the resource ID that made the change, and the subscribed fields as request parameters (text fields only). This shows who changed client contacts, configuration items or tickets, not logins. Samples follow the field list and example on Autotask's webhook page with the values changed. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (48 of 48 fields matched the emulator). The engine's FLATTEN keeps the payload's key order, where the emulator sorts the keys, so request_parameters can come out in a different order. No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
